text:
maria_cs: Quick sync — we're kicking off the Orion preview cohort next week. Need to align ambassador enablement + feedback cadence. Can volunteers run a 30m enablement session? Also need survey flow + recording consent language. cc @alex_success @tyler_eng

alex_success: I can run the enablement but prefer Tue 11am PT. I have a 30m slot we can use. Agenda draft? :spiral_calendar:

tyler_eng: Re recording: engineering prefers recordings only with explicit consent. We can auto-anonymize logs and redact transcripts. I'll share a consent snippet. @ops_bot can you drop the survey link?

ops_bot: Survey template and consent copy uploaded: https://redwood.surveys/preview-orion
Consent blurb: "By joining you consent to anonymized session notes and aggregated feedback."
Calendar invite snippet:
```
Invite: Tue Nov 14 11:00 PT
Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/123456789
Pre-read: https://go.redwood/docs/orion-onboard
```

sam_prod: Can we add a 10m product walkthrough on performance and Dedicated mode? Short demo + Q&A.

maria_cs: Yes — put that at the top of the agenda. Also flagging two preview customers as potential renewal-risk if we don't get SSO and billing visibility sorted. Need a quick SSO checklist in the pre-read. @tyler_eng any ETA on SSO docs?

tyler_eng: Docs draft by Wed EOD. Will include checklist and integration playbook. Can we get a list of customer SSO providers so I can add examples?

jenna_client: Thanks — Tue 11am PT works for our team. We'll invite 3 engineers. Recording is fine if transcripts are redacted. Looking forward to the walkthrough.

alex_success: Great — I'll lock Tue 11am, send calendar + pre-read by Monday. I'll also own the post-session NPS micro-survey 24h after. :calendar:

maria_cs: Perfect. I'll prep the feedback capture sheet (simple rows: attendee, role, pain, ask, follow-up owner) and share here after the enablement. Thanks everyone! :tada:
